# Slavic Evangelical Baptist Church of Orange County

> Славянская Евангельская Баптистская Церковь округа Ориндж. A Russian-speaking Slavic Baptist congregation in Anaheim, California. Sunday worship at 2:00 PM.

Service times: Sunday worship at 2:00 PM; Bible study on Tuesdays 7:30 PM–9:00 PM (via Skype: live:rusevchurch). Location: 310 S Lemon St, Anaheim, CA 92805 (building kindly provided by Bethel Baptist Church). Mailing address: PO Box 248, Chino, CA 91708-0248. Primary language: Russian.

## Pages

- [Home](https://rusevchurch.pages.dev/): Main page with worship times and overview
- [About / Sunday worship (О Нас)](https://rusevchurch.pages.dev/#about): Welcome and what to expect at Sunday service
- [Events (События)](https://rusevchurch.pages.dev/#events): Sunday worship and Tuesday Bible study details
- [Statement of faith (Вероучение)](https://rusevchurch.pages.dev/#beliefs): The church's beliefs and doctrine
- [Location (Местонахождение)](https://rusevchurch.pages.dev/#venue): Address, parking, and map
- [Contact info (Информация)](https://rusevchurch.pages.dev/#contact): Address, email, and service times
